title: secp256k1-ecdlp: six-class rho with a load-normalized end-to-end success census (126.338)

claims.statement: For uniform full-production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold six-class negation+GLV parallel Pollard rho attack specified in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.3911 under the disclosed heuristic H1, and on every run its total work is at most 2^126.338 target-group-operation equivalents because a global meter charges every action before it runs. The exact integer ledger total is W_ledger = 107529267059811478367772329467123690012431 milli-units = 2^126.337997 units (phase 1 0.752*(S_ops+2^60) < 2^126.3296, hard extras < 2^107.156, Markov allowance 2^118.910); 126.338 = 63169/500 is that total's three-decimal ceiling, and certificate.py proves W_ledger^500 < 1000^500*2^63169 and W_ledger^1000 > 1000^1000*2^126337 in exact integers. A step is charged its counted 752 AArch64 instructions from kernels/secp_loops.s (111 + 523 per walk, executed by the interpreter in experiment.py against affine arithmetic), the doubling escape 0.956 units and the traversal step 0.776; the report store, the seven counter widths and the block refills are those of proof.md section 3. SUCCESS IS MEASURED END TO END, NOT INHERITED FROM A MERGE STATISTIC. With nu = operations/sqrt(N_class) the ledger row is nu_ledger = S_ops/sqrt(N') = 1.023328, and the census measures p at nu = 0.4093, 0.7163, 1.0233 and 1.3303 on five groups that hold lambda = mean trail/sqrt(N) fixed at 0.006765 while sqrt(N) doubles from 2,365 to 75,684 (a 32x span): 2365 (dp 4), 4730 (dp 5), 18921 (dp 7), 37843 (dp 8), 75684 (dp 9). Each cell is 512 fresh fixtures x 1 trial through the shipped walk (experiment.py Walker._run, the same code path Part B uses, reached through run_trail_budgeted) with every operation charged to a global meter before it runs, so a fixture performs exactly round(nu*sqrt(N)) operations; the harness asserts |V/sqrt(N) - nu| <= 1e-3 in every cell (max 0.000175). A fixture succeeds only if two distinct trails collide at a distinguished class AND the shipped re-walk, coefficient solve and verification return the generated secret (x == x_secret and [x]P == Q); recovery is never chained from occupancy. At the ledger load the pooled measurement is 2098/5120 = 0.4098 with exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% lower endpoint 0.3984 (10 cells, per group 0.4355, 0.3926, 0.4082, 0.4102, 0.4004, 0.4570, 0.3965, 0.3730, 0.4023, 0.4219), and the independent replication gives 1050/2560 = 0.4102. The fit p(nu) = 1 - exp(-c*nu^2) gives c = 0.5067 with RMS residual 0.0032 and maximum residual 0.0059 over the four anchors (free exponent 2.00, RMS 0.0032), i.e. the birthday form H1 assumes, and it reproduces P0 = 0.3953 at nu_ledger to within its residual band. Trap repair, DP recovery, cap and restart behaviour are counted at the same normalized load: the 2-cycle repair fires at 7.2e-04 per operation against the model 1/(6R) = 6.5e-4 for the R = 256 partition, and p is flat over a 16x span of that rate (R = 64 gives 0.3994, R = 256 gives 0.4098, R = 1024 gives 0.4219), so success is not carried by the repair machinery; cap abandonments stay at or below 0.0078 per fixture and exceptional additions at or below 0.0020, and every one of the 6121 recorded merges in the 17408 fixtures is re-walked and verified. The off-ladder group q29 (cofactor 3, trail length 1.73x the target) gives 0.3984 at the ledger load, a measured sensitivity to the normalized trail length. The one normalized quantity a fixture cannot match is the budget per trail, V/lambda_sqrtN: 157 here against 2^63.8 in production, where a merge has vastly more room to reach its distinguished point, so the fixture regime is the tighter one and the measured p transfers as a lower bound, with the step from 2^22.4..2^32.4 class spaces to 2^253.4 labelled as an extrapolation. A known-answer gate ran before any scale-up (320/320 hand-verified fixtures solved), every fixture draws a fresh RNG from a fresh seed, and evidence/nu-census.json carries the per-cell rows, pooled anchors, fit residuals, repair-rate and trail-length sensitivities, budget assertions and gate rows. Peak memory is below 2^72 bytes, preprocessing is capped at 2^59.0 units and included, no nonuniform advice is used. This is an analytical, heuristic bound, not a practical break.
